query: PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?scenario ?assessment ?product ?evidence WHERE { t:riskResult l:resultAssessment ?assessment ; l:citesSourceRecord ?evidence . ?assessment l:assessmentScenario ?scenario . ?scenario l:scenarioProduct ?product }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?plan WHERE { ?plan l:planRiskResult t:riskResult . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?a l:implementsRiskPlan ?plan } }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?old ?new ?source ?conclusion WHERE { t:review l:reviewPriorResult ?old ; l:reviewNewResult ?new . ?new l:citesSourceRecord ?source ; l:conclusion ?conclusion }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?target ?source WHERE { t:signal l:signalSubstance ?target ; l:citesSourceRecord ?source }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?assessment ?status ?time WHERE { ?r l:pvResultSignal t:signal ; l:pvResultAssessment ?assessment ; l:signalStatus ?status ; l:atTime ?time }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?activity ?requirement ?jurisdiction WHERE { ?activity l:surveillanceRequirement ?requirement . ?requirement l:pvRequirementJurisdiction ?jurisdiction }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?org WHERE { t:cap c:capabilityBearer ?org . FILTER NOT EXISTS { t:cap l:capabilityRealizedIn ?x } }
PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?cap WHERE { t:service l:serviceCapability ?cap }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?artifact ?org WHERE { { ?artifact a c:BusinessArchitectureView ; l:viewOrganization ?org } UNION { ?artifact a c:StrategicPartnershipAgreement ; c:partnershipParticipant ?org } }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?component ?version WHERE { t:record l:recordDigitalActivity/l:digitalActivityDeployment ?d . ?d l:deploymentComponent ?component ; l:componentVersion ?version }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?activity ?component ?operator WHERE { t:record l:recordDigitalActivity ?activity . ?activity l:digitalActivityDeployment ?deployment . ?deployment l:deploymentComponent ?component ; l:deploymentOrganization ?operator }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?org ?version ?time WHERE { ?d l:deploymentOrganization ?org ; l:componentVersion ?version ; l:atTime ?time }
